5.1.3: DIH Client for Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1

**New: Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1** (Fabric)
- DIH Client now also runs on Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1 (26.1.2). Install the Fabric jar for your version with the
  matching Fabric API.
- 1.21.11 runs on Java 21, the version its launchers ship with.

**Not on 1.21.11 yet**
- OreSim, the lightmap-based Fullbright, X-ray block filtering, Better Chat, the in-chat command suggestions and the
  No Render options for world time, fluids and the framerate limiter are off on 1.21.11.

**On 26.1**
- No friends list buttons (26.1 has no friends list), and the pause menu shows Open to LAN instead of the
  multiplayer options.

Fabric, NeoForge and Forge on Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3; Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1.
